name: Microsoft Entra (Graph)
description: Experimental. 73 Microsoft Graph operations used by the Entra admin center: users, groups, members and owners, administrative units, roles, PIM requests, organization. 0.1.2: delete a group, remove a member or owner accept 204. 0.1.1: create a group inside an administrative unit with its description and owners in one request; add member/owner accepts 204. The sign-in recipe is account-specific and not shipped (auth.storage is empty): add it as a reviewed local patch from your own signed-in Entra browser before use. No tenant data is included.
